name: New Zealand
description: New Zealand from the Māori voyagers to Cook, the Treaty of Waitangi, the wars, votes for women, Hillary and today.

checkpoints.name: Aotearoa
checkpoints.note: Polynesian voyagers settled the islands around 1300 and became the Māori. Tasman passed by in 1642.

checkpoints.name: Colony
checkpoints.note: Cook mapped the coasts in 1769. The Treaty of Waitangi of 1840 began British rule, wars over land followed, and women won the vote in 1893.

checkpoints.name: Dominion and nation
checkpoints.note: New Zealand became a dominion in 1907. Hillary climbed Everest, Māori rights were restored step by step, and the country took its own path.
